import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ProjectiveTwistNontrivial
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CurveDivisorDegreePositivity
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModules

/-!
# Positive degree of the carried projective twist

An effective divisor presenting a relatively very ample bundle on a smooth
proper geometrically integral curve is nonzero: the zero divisor would make
the bundle trivial. Its residue-weighted degree is therefore strictly positive.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CurveDivisor

/-- An effective divisor presenting a projective twist on a proper curve has
strictly positive degree over its original field. -/
theorem deg_pos_of_isProjectiveWith
    {k : Type} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] {L : C.left.Modules}
    (h : C.hom.IsProjectiveWith L) :
    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    ∀ (D : C.left.CurveDivisor), 0 ≤ D →
      (L ≅ Scheme.divisorModules k D) → 0 < deg k D := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  intro D hD e
  apply deg_pos_of_nonneg_of_ne_zero hD
  intro hzero
  subst D
  exact Scheme.Hom.IsProjectiveWith.not_nonempty_iso_unit_of_curve C h
    ⟨e ≪≫ Scheme.divisorModulesZeroIso k⟩

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CurveDivisor
